claims.claim: Solventum is a global healthcare company that develops, manufactures and commercializes solutions that combine material science, data science and digital capabilities to serve the full patient journey.
claims.quote: Solventum Corporation ("Solventum," "we," "our," "us," or the "Company"), is a leading global healthcare company developing, manufacturing, and commercializing a broad portfolio of solutions that leverages deep material science, data science, and digital capabilities to address critical customer and patient needs.

claims.claim: The company organizes its operations into three reportable segments: MedSurg, Dental Solutions and Health Information Systems.
claims.quote: We are organized into three reportable operating business segments that are aligned with the markets we serve.

claims.claim: Strong customer relationships and a well‑known brand portfolio are cited as core competitive strengths.
claims.quote: Our business possesses strong customer relationships, a broad, wide-ranging, and well‑known portfolio of brands, differentiated technology, and manufacturing expertise.

claims.claim: MedSurg contributed the majority of 2025 sales, reflecting its central role in the company’s revenue mix.
claims.quote: MedSurg (57.9% of 2025 total sales) is a provider of solutions including negative pressure wound therapy, advanced wound dressings, advanced skin care, synthetic tissue matrices, I.V. site management, sterilization assurance, temperature management, surgical supplies, medical tapes and wraps, stethoscopes, medical electrodes, and medical technologies Original Equipment Manufacturer ("OEM").

claims.claim: Management expects organic sales growth for the full year to be near the high end of the 2.5%‑3.0% range.
claims.quote: Increased organic sales growth range toward the high end of +2.5% to +3.0% (toward the high end of +3.5% to +4.0% excluding ~100 bps of SKU exit impact)

claims.claim: The company raised its adjusted earnings‑per‑share guidance to a range of $7.20‑$7.30 for FY 2026.
claims.quote: Increased adjusted EPS range to $7.20 to $7.30; from prior range of $7.10 to $7.20

claims.claim: Competitive pressures are highlighted across all segments, including emerging AI‑enabled rivals in health‑information‑systems.
claims.quote: Principal competitors include Optum, Microsoft (Nuance), Epic, Oracle (Cerner), Waystar, Athena, and a host of start-up technologies actively working to disrupt the areas of revenue cycle management and clinician productivity.

claims.claim: Solventum has completed roughly ninety percent of its transition services with its former parent 3M and finished the planned ERP system cutover.
claims.quote: •Have exited ~90% of 3M transition service agreements; ERP system cutovers complete

claims.claim: The company is pursuing a multiyear restructuring program called “Transform for the Future” to lower costs and improve operating efficiency.
claims.quote: Solventum has initiated a multiyear restructuring program, 'Transform for the Future', which is designed to further enable its long‑term growth strategy and ensure it's best positioned to compete‑to‑win in a rapidly changing healthcare environment.

claims.claim: Recent acquisitions include Acera Surgical, and a divestiture of the Purification & Filtration business, indicating an ongoing portfolio reshaping.
claims.quote: In 2025, the Company acquired Acera Surgical ("Acera"), a privately held bioscience company. Also in 2025, the Company sold its Purification and Filtration business to Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.

claims.claim: Management flags AI deployment as both a growth opportunity and a source of cost and execution risk.
claims.quote: Solventum has begun to deploy AI in its products and services, including as part of its research and development efforts, and Solventum expects to continue to explore additional uses as AI continues to develop.

claims.claim: The firm’s debt load of approximately $5 billion could constrain future capital raising and increase financing costs.
claims.quote: as of December 31, 2025, Solventum had approximately $5 billion of outstanding indebtedness.

claims.claim: Risk factors note that post‑spin‑off reliance on 3M for raw material supply could impair operations if 3M fails to meet requirements.
claims.quote: 3M is the sole source of supply for raw materials used in certain of our products and our business will be harmed if 3M does not satisfy our requirements.

claims.claim: Management emphasizes that failure to achieve anticipated spin‑off benefits would adversely affect competitive positioning.
claims.quote: Solventum may not achieve these and other anticipated benefits for a variety of reasons... it could have a material adverse effect on its competitive position, business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

claims.claim: Judgment: Prioritize completion of the remaining transition services with 3M and accelerate adoption of AI‑enabled functionality in Health Information Systems to mitigate competitive risk.
claims.quote: Solventum has begun to deploy AI in its products and services, including as part of its research and development efforts, and Solventum expects to continue to explore additional uses as AI continues to develop.

gaps: The 10‑K does not provide a quantified forecast of market share trends beyond the qualitative statements in the risk factors.
The filing does not disclose specific timelines for the rollout of new AI‑enabled products beyond the general intent to continue development.
